hadith:
Oppressions - Narrated `Umar:

When Allah took away the soul of His Prophet at his death, the Ansar assembled In the shed of Bani Sa`ida. I said to Abu Bakr, "Let us go." So, we come to them (i.e. to Ansar) at the shed of Bani Sa`ida. (See Hadith No. 19, Vol. 5 for details)
message: Remember that Allah, in His role as Ar-Rasheed (The Most Righteous Guide), watches all our actions and records them—so strive to be mindful of your deeds and seek His guidance in righteousness. Reflect on the fate of those who came before us and rejected guidance, and let their example be a reminder to turn towards Allah with sincere intention. Ask yourself: am I following the path of truth that Allah has shown me, or am I heedless of His signs?
name:
Ar Rasheed - الرَّشِيدُ - The Most Righteous Guide

The name Ar-Rasheed conveys the idea of Allah being the one who leads and guides believers towards the path of righteousness and truth. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'راشد' (r-sh-d), which pertains to guidance and correctness. It appears in various Islamic teachings, emphasizing the importance of seeking guidance from Allah in all aspects of life.
verse:
Al-Qamar - The Moon - 54:51-52
